reference_source.origin_note: Local slhdsa-c README declares derivation from SLotH driver; no independent .git directory present.
reference_source.instrumentation: SLH_EXPERIMENTAL enables existing compression counters and expands scratch limits; uninstrumented build independently compared byte-for-byte

cache_audit_and_independent_xmss_c.scope: Read-only review of frozen candidate B and repaired frozen candidate C; private four-context XMSS cold-fill race reproduction; independent pinned XMSS C h10 Keygen/Sign. No production RTL edits, synthesis or routing by auditor.

static_checks.evidence: cached_public_phase(initial_phase): XMSS batch SEED excluded, no-seed chains and scalar shape8 KEY included; scalar INDEX/seed generation excluded.
Recomputed from following_phase on final restart: SEED/FINAL→KEY eligible; KEY→MASK0 and MASK0→MASK1 eligible; final mask→FINAL excluded.

One raw256-bit CV bank reused. Algorithm bit separates SLH and XMSS; SLH compares low128 seed bits, XMSS compares all256. Prefix_data uses domain3||public_seed, while INDEX uses secret_prf and keygen uses domain4||secret_seed.

C adds return_schedulable guard on next-phase eligibility during pending/described fill; normal scheduler already gates eligible block0. Intermediate block returns bypass the guard and can finish the cold fill.
valid/pending, descriptor flag, context eligibility, and lane in-flight state reset. Uninitialized CV/identity payload is inaccessible while valid=0.

Cache CV is separate from per-context intermediate CV/key/digest/captured. Block0 explicitly selects IV, warm block1 selects cached CV, later blocks select returned intermediate CV. KEY/MASK0/MASK1 capture sequencing unchanged.
Logical padded-block vectors/native counters retained. H=S+3U+4B+M and PRFs=2U+3B=[2(H−S−M)+B]/3; actual blocks=logical−PRFs+1 cold fill. Each completed logical hash still increments hash_count once.

race_regression.stimulus: Only batch group3, four XMSS contexts, family1, leaf65536, a1..4, seeded chains steps1/2/3/4, midpoint captures and held responses; COUNT=0 skips scalar cases.

trace.event: tag0 SEED final return direct-reserved KEY
tag0 cold public PRF prefix launched
tag1 SEED final return direct-reserved KEY despite pending=1
tag1 second cold launch with pending=1 triggers already-in-flight assertion
tag1 final return blocked from direct reservation; its KEY need_block retained
tag0 cold intermediate block return remains schedulable
fill valid, waiting tags arbitrate normally

repaired_c.checks: All four final digests and captures match independent full-message hashlib vectors; held responses and raw hash/block/prefix transaction counts pass.
repaired_c.note: The inherited bench final display says batch_groups=6; this private reduction actually executes exactly one XMSS group, as shown by its source loop bounds.

independent_xmss_c.command: Python: model.reference.stateful_native.generate("xmss_h10", Job loaded from tb/vectors/sha2/xmss_h10/sign/job.mem, message from message.mem, "sha2"); pinned C signer also verifies generated signature internally.
independent_xmss_c.rtl_comparison_limit: Independent C output equals frozen target vector; complete candidate-C RTL Sign comparison remains the main validation runner responsibility.

limitations: This audit does not claim complete matrix/function regression or new routed frequency closure.
No h20 complete Keygen/Sign was generated or run.
Raw detailed logs remain in run directory; only this summary is intended for archive.

additional_height_and_shake_verify.h20_scope: Synthetic independent standard one-leaf Verify boundary fixtures at q=2^20-1; no full-tree Keygen/Sign generation or execution

first_attempt_failure.cause: Private adapter kept stale declared32-byte length while software signed one stored byte; changed private cfg[8] to actual payload length1. No production RTL change.

rejected_candidate_b.stopped_for: Confirmed duplicate prefix cold-fill race; root authorized stopping erroneous candidate
